ravi: hey team, first day—my kit arrived but the USB Wi-Fi adapter is missing. desk 5E, cant connect to flaky wall jack. anyone know next steps? :wave:

it_maya: welcome ravi! sorry about that. can you share packing slip or order number? we can loan a dongle for the day or provision guest wifi. also, try plugging dock directly to laptop to see if wifi enumerates.

ravi: packing slip ONB-1122. i tried direct to laptop, still no wifi interface. need wifi for a 2pm onboarding call.

logistics_joe: checking ONB-1122looks like the accessory was omitted at fulfillment. i'll request a same-day courier and drop a loaner at 13:30. if courier fails, we'll ship expedited tomorrow AM.

it_maya: temporary: connect to Redwood-Guest and use SMS auth; i'll open a short-lived ethernet pass for your MAC if you need stable connection for the call. also logged ticket TKT-5055 for missing peripheral.

it-bot: Ticket TKT-5055 created and assigned to Logistics. ETA loaner drop 13:30.

ravi: great thanks 13:30 works. appreciate the rescue :pray:
